value.summary: The change replaces `use openhuman_core::openhuman as oh;` with `use openhuman_core as oh;`, redirecting the `oh` qualifier from a submodule to the crate root. The diff is only one line and touches no other code, so any breakage would come from callers using `oh::something` that resolves differently now. No such callers appear in the diff, and there is no evidence of a renamed path or a missing re-export. The change appears safe, but if other parts of the crate depend on items re-exported through the old `openhuman_core::openhuman` module that are not available at the crate root, those callers would break — that is not visible here and remains the author’s responsibility to verify. With what is shown, I cannot identify a defect, so no findings are reported.
